title.value: High-Order Pooling for Graph Neural Networks with Tensor Decomposition
title.justification: The title is directly stated in the paper and accurately reflects the content discussed, focusing on pooling methods in Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) using tensor decomposition.
title.quote: High-Order Pooling for Graph Neural Networks with Tensor Decomposition

extractions.description: The paper introduces the Tensorized Graph Neural Network (tGNN), an advanced GNN architecture that leverages tensor decomposition to capture high-order non-linear node interactions. This is achieved using a permutation-invariant approach through symmetric CP decomposition, providing a more expressive pooling method compared to traditional linear operations in GNNs. The paper presents both theoretical and empirical analysis demonstrating tGNN's superior performance on classification tasks on node and graph datasets.
